reason: This changes a central expression-context contract: where `BuildContext` gets session location/timezone state. That is user-visible semantic state and can affect expression building/evaluation, column/default/generated-column behavior, and session-scoped correctness. The touch set is cross-cutting rather than local (`pkg/expression/**`, `pkg/session/session.go`, `pkg/table/column.go`, plus DDL/session-pool plumbing and a planner test), which raises blast radius beyond a routine refactor.
